expectations.text: Does not call or plan an AskUserQuestion / blocking question about the split
expectations.evidence: 'Nothing here needs you before you go... You'd wake up to a status line, not a question.' Step 9: 'I don't ask you anything'.

expectations.text: Files the split itself as sub-issues of #14 with native blocked_by edges between serial parts
expectations.evidence: Step 4: gh issue create x3, POST issues/14/sub_issues for each, blocked_by edges C2<-C1 and C3<-C2 using database ids; copies #14's open blockers onto C1.

expectations.text: Records the split as a decision on the issue (comment) the user can reverse
expectations.evidence: gh issue comment 14 '## ORCHESTRATOR DECISION — split into ... To reverse, close the three parts.'

expectations.text: Does not dispatch #14 itself as a single lane
expectations.evidence: Decision comment rejects 'implement as one lane'; '#14 stays open as the container'; only impl-$C1 is dispatched.

expectations.text: Advances PR #52 toward merge (ready, CI, merge) rather than leaving it waiting
expectations.evidence: Step 1 read-only sanity check, step 2: gh pr ready, update-branch if BEHIND, checks watch, gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch, verify #12 closed.

expectations.text: Any CI watch is run in the background, not foreground-blocking
expectations.evidence: '# run_in_background: true' annotated on gh pr checks 52 --watch --interval 60 --fail-fast.

expectations.text: Dispatches (or plans to dispatch) the first split part as an implementer
expectations.evidence: Step 7: claim $C1, Agent subagent_type orchestrate-issues:implementer, worktree, name impl-$C1, run_in_background true.

expectations.text: Every agent dispatch uses an orchestrate-issues:<role> subagent_type (not general-purpose)
expectations.evidence: The one concrete dispatch (impl-$C1) uses subagent_type orchestrate-issues:implementer; the possible third-lane dispatch is 'an opus implementer'. No general-purpose.

expectations.text: Dispatches send a lane card of variable fields rather than restating the role's full instructions
expectations.evidence: impl-$C1 card holds only REPO/ISSUE/BRANCH/BASE, verbatim ISSUE BODY, a short VERIFIED CONTEXT and an optional RESERVED line, matching the lane-cards template.
